description: Xquik documentation for REST API, webhooks, MCP, OAuth, SDKs, extraction workflows, monitors, and X/Twitter automation. Not affiliated with X Corp.
rules: Use x-api-quickstart.mdx first for the initial API key and authenticated request flow.
Use api-reference/overview.mdx for REST base URL, auth, errors, rate limits, pagination, and 129 documented REST operations.
Use guides/guest-wallets.mdx for 33 prepaid paid-read GET routes and mpp/machine-payments-protocol.mdx for 7 fixed-price direct MPP operations.

Treat these counts as stale: 118, 120, 127, or 128 REST operations; 119 or 120 full-scope MCP operations; 31 or 32 MPP read endpoints; or 33 direct MPP reads. Current counts: 129 REST operations, 118 full-scope JSON or text MCP routes, 33 guest paid-read operations, and 7 direct MPP operations.
Use sdks/ for TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, PHP, CLI, and Terraform install docs.
Use mcp/ for API MCP v2.6.38, Streamable HTTP, explore and xquik code-mode tools, normalized responses, guarded pagination, and compact agent output.

Use mcp/overview.mdx for the current client setup matrix. Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline, Qwen Code, and Codex CLI 0.147.0 or newer support Xquik OAuth. Older Codex and affected Goose releases require an environment-backed API key. Roo Code is archived and API-key only. Pi has no native MCP client.

If Codex CLI older than 0.147.0 or Goose reports Authorization server response missing required issuer: expected https://xquik.com, read guides/troubleshooting.mdx and https://docs.xquik.com/guides/troubleshooting#codex-oauth-issuer-validation-error. Xquik already returns RFC 9207 iss and keeps issuer validation enabled. Upgrade Codex when possible. Older Codex releases use bearer_token_env_var = XQUIK_API_KEY. Issue https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/31573 records the Codex fix.
Use guides/guest-wallets.mdx for accountless hosted checkouts from $10-$250 USD, paid_reads scope, verified activation, explicit confirmation, and direct REST credential routes.
Use webhooks/ for signed event delivery.
Use guides/workflows.mdx for job selection across tweet search, followers, media tweets, DMs, monitor webhooks, SDK, and MCP handoffs.
Use guides/tweet-scraper-csv-export.mdx, guides/tweet-replies-export.mdx, and guides/follower-export-crm.mdx for CSV, JSON, XLSX exports.
Use guides/media-upload-workflow.mdx and guides/direct-message-workflow.mdx for media URLs, DM media_ids, returned message IDs, and JSONL handoffs.
Keep implementation details public-safe; use Xquik, read service, write service, or browser service wording.
